scope: Generic WIC operating-state validity, evaporator airflow/icing, defrost/drain/fan-delay.
principles: Interpret refrigeration readings in operating-state context; do not treat defrost, post-defrost, pump-down or satisfied-state readings as stable-cooling evidence.
An iced evaporator is a condition, not automatically a failed defrost heater.
Icing can arise from defrost setup/function, airflow/fan problems, infiltration/moisture, drain/refreeze, low evaporating temperature, or refrigerant-feed problems.
Defrost diagnosis is sequence-based: initiation -> refrigeration off -> heat/air/hot-gas action -> termination/failsafe -> drain/drip -> refrigeration restart -> fan delay/restart.

operating_states.diagnostic_use: Primary state for SH/SC and steady refrigeration-pattern interpretation after stabilization.
operating_states.validity: usable when load/control state is reasonably steady

operating_states.diagnostic_use: High load/transient; some measurements useful but generic steady targets may not apply.
Cooling demand satisfied; solenoid/compressor may be off or pumping down.
operating_states.validity: do not diagnose active refrigeration performance from off-cycle readings

operating_states.diagnostic_use: Liquid feed intentionally stopped while compressor lowers suction.
operating_states.validity: low suction is expected sequence behavior, not starvation evidence by itself

operating_states.diagnostic_use: Refrigeration intentionally interrupted/altered; heaters/hot gas/air defrost may operate.
operating_states.validity: SH/SC fault diagnosis generally suspended; validate defrost sequence instead

operating_states.diagnostic_use: Drain/drip and fan delay/recovery can intentionally alter airflow and temperatures.
operating_states.validity: do not treat temporary fan-off/warm coil behavior as normal cooling fault
wait for appropriate stabilization before steady-state interpretation

operating_states.diagnostic_use: State must be established before high-confidence interpretation.
operating_states.validity: degrade diagnostic confidence and ask state/sequence check

domains.condition: Insufficient heat transfer because evaporator air movement is reduced.
discriminators: entering/leaving air temperatures in proper state
domains.diagnosis_policy: Local fan/coil/air-path evidence is required before naming airflow root cause.

domains.condition: Evaporator partly/completely blocked by frost or ice.
discriminators: suction/evap temperature/feed after coil is clear
domains.diagnosis_policy: Icing is a condition; localize cause before replacing defrost parts.

domains.condition: Defrost sequence does not remove accumulated frost/ice as designed.
supporting: coil remains iced after scheduled defrost
look_alikes: excess moisture/infiltration overwhelms otherwise functional defrost
domains.diagnosis_policy: Diagnose failed sequence step, not generic 'defrost problem' when evidence localizes it.

domains.condition: Defrost water does not leave correctly and refreezes.
Evaporator fans resume at an incorrect point after defrost.
domains.diagnosis_policy: Separate intentional fan delay from fan failure.
